brief: Crews should bring forward the detailed inspection for Kingsley Green 138/13kV (SUB-SGW-699) prior to the heat event, as its maintenance interval compliance is overdue and its cooling system unverified [REG-042]. Because this unit uses ONAN cooling, the cooling stage de-rating rules in MG-021 do not require forced cooling adjustments, but ambient and sustained event de-ratings must be applied if thresholds are met [MG-021]. Record every de-rating applied along with its reason, value, and period, and restore the full rating only after underlying conditions are corrected and verified [MG-021].
